text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Academic transcript of highest education 6.Two letters of reference One from associate professor and above, one from previous employer 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English 8.GMAT or GRE certificate Authorized Copy of GMAT certificate with score of 550 or GRE certificate with score of 1100 or above within the period of validity of 5 years.
